title: Array read
summary: Evaluates the compiler's bounds-checked array read: xs[k.toNat]! for an array laid out in memory, which is 0 past the length.
premises: UInt64Array.At for the array in the store
The array local holds the array's pointer
result: The read evaluates to xs[k.toNat]! and leaves the state with the position saved in the read's scratch local.
